name: FADE calls Gatehouse: story acceptance goes through the external gate
executiveNote: Ends builder self-certification. STORY_DONE stops meaning done and starts meaning candidate: FADE hands the story's diff, requirement, and the repo's gatehouse.yml to the external `gatehouse` CLI (github.com/themitchelli/gatehouse, v0 complete 2026-07-19) and only marks passes:true on exit 0. Design agreed in vault sessions 2026-07-19; verdict routing per the GATE-004 flow discussion.
technicalNotes: Gatehouse contract (stable v0): `gatehouse review --diff <ref-range> --requirement <path> --policy gatehouse.yml --work-id <id>` -> exit 0 pass / 1 blocking / 2 could_not_run / 3 tests_failed; findings at .gatehouse/evidence/findings.json (kinds: ac_invalidating, new_scope, advisory, protected_path); append-only evidence JSONL. Integration is OPT-IN: only active when the target repo contains gatehouse.yml AND `gatehouse` is on PATH (or FADE_GATEHOUSE_BIN set); otherwise current behaviour is unchanged. FOCAL POINTS: (1) the story-start commit must be recorded when the story begins so the diff is exactly this story's work — never derive the diff by matching story ids against history (review-sweep lesson); (2) exit 2 halts the loop, never retries, never proceeds; (3) FADE must not implement its own remediation counting — pass the same --work-id (PRD-id/story-id) and let the gate's bound decide; (4) passes:true may only be written after exit 0 — no code path may set it from STORY_DONE alone when the gate is active.

userStories.title: Record story-start commit and construct the story-scoped diff
acceptanceCriteria: When a story's builder iteration starts and gatehouse integration is active, FADE records the current HEAD as the story-start ref in the run directory (fade/runs/<id>/story-start-<story>.ref)
The diff passed to gatehouse is exactly <story-start>..HEAD at STORY_DONE time; no diff construction consults story ids, PRD ids, or archive history
If the story-start ref is missing or unreadable at STORY_DONE time, FADE does NOT call gatehouse with a guessed diff; it halts with an explicit error (treated as could_not_run)
Tests cover: normal capture, missing ref halting, and diff exactness when unrelated commits exist before story start
userStories.rationale: Diff scoping is where the 2026-07-14 review-sweep incident started; the ref file makes the scope explicit and testable.

userStories.title: Call the gate on STORY_DONE and route the four verdicts
acceptanceCriteria: When active, the STORY_DONE branch invokes gatehouse review with the story diff, the PRD file plus story id as requirement, the repo's gatehouse.yml, and --work-id <prd-id>/<story-id>
Exit 0: passes:true is set, progress.md notes the gate verdict, loop continues as today

Exit 1: passes stays false; FADE starts one remediation iteration whose prompt is built from .gatehouse/evidence/findings.json (the ac_invalidating findings and the reviewed diff), then re-invokes the gate with the same work-id; if the gate reports the bound exhausted, FADE halts and writes the operator question
Exit 2: the loop halts immediately with the gate's stderr surfaced; no retry, no remediation iteration, no archive
Exit 3: routes to the existing test-failure flow (failure log becomes the fix task), replacing the separate run_regression_tests call when the gate is active
new_scope findings are written as draft:true PRD stubs in fade/prds/ named GH-SCOPE-<n>; advisory findings are appended to the run log only
When gatehouse.yml is absent or the binary is not found, behaviour is byte-identical to current FADE (verified by test)
Tests mock the gatehouse binary and cover all four exit codes, bound exhaustion, new_scope stub creation, and the inactive path
userStories.rationale: The verdict routing is the whole point: the gate decides, FADE obeys, and no FADE code path can promote a story the gate did not pass.

userStories.title: Gate the archive: no PRD archives with unreviewed stories
acceptanceCriteria: When active, ALL_COMPLETE/archive paths verify every story in the PRD carries a recorded gate pass (evidence of exit 0 in the run records) before archiving
A PRD with any story lacking a gate pass does not archive; FADE reports which stories are unreviewed and halts that PRD's archive only
The check reads recorded verdicts from this run's records; it never re-enumerates other PRDs or triggers new reviews (no sweep behaviour)
Tests cover: clean archive, one-unreviewed-story refusal, and that refusal touches no other queued PRD
userStories.rationale: Merged-but-not-reviewed drift is the gap ENH-029 named; the archive gate closes it at the moment it matters.
